about: MegaMek suite design tokens: the one source of truth for Swing and libGDX. Colors are #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA in sRGB. 'overlay' is the translucent value a surface uses when it is drawn over the board (libGDX); opaque Swing surfaces use 'dark'. 'colorblind' holds the dark and light values of the color-blind safe palette where they differ from the standard ones. Sizes are logical pixels at scale 1. See docs/design-system/tokens.md.

surface.raised.use: Headers, footers and sections raised from a panel.

surface.hover.use: Hover wash laid over any surface.

surface.inverse.use: Inverted (cream) faces: the primary button and every control that is on: a checked toggle or icon toggle, the selected segment, an on chip, a checked box, radio or switch.

surface.inverseDisabled.use: A disabled control that is on: surface.inverse faint over the control's surface, with text.onInverse and no edge. Its label is as faint as other disabled text, on purpose.

surface.scrim.use: Dims the window behind a modal card.

text.disabled.use: Disabled text; exempt from contrast minimums.

border.subtle.use: Decorative dividers and panel rails; never the only cue.

border.strong.use: Hovered control edge, corner ticks at full frame.

accent.primary.use: Brand accent: focus, progress, slider fill, links, info, badges.

focus.ring.use: Keyboard focus ring: 2 wide inside the edge, or a 1 gap outside a small indicator or a cream (surface.inverse) face.

selected.primary.use: Selected/current item in a collection: row marker, tab underline, edge of a selected panel, menu check, map selection. The inverse color, so mint stays for focus, progress and links.

selected.background.use: Selected row, cell or panel wash, laid over its surface: a neutral wash, twice the hover one, so selection stays apart from hover.

status.info.use: Neutral information; shares the accent on purpose.

typography.caseRule: Each screen is in app or game mode. App mode upper-cases only overline tags. Game mode also upper-cases the short framing labels of one to three words: the phase banner, headlines, titles and section headers, buttons and tabs. Body text, values, tables, tooltips and field labels stay sentence case in both modes. Strings stay sentence case; case is applied when the text is drawn.

body.strong.use: Emphasis, values, and unit and pilot names (the name role).

width.rule: Type is Roboto at regular width (wdth 100). Game mode sets the framing labels and unit and pilot names in Roboto Condensed (wdth 75) at the same weight and tracking; body, small, caption, field labels, tables, values and running text stay regular width. App mode is all regular width, the overline included.

contrast.why: Accent and status colors may be used as text

checks.visionRule: The standard palette is measured for normal vision; the colorblind palette for every simulated vision type.

distinct.why: The accent (and so focus and info) is not mistaken for a status
